notes: West of Vine is Garfield Pl. (126', north edge y~796, south edge y~1234, centre y~1015), east of Vine E 8th (north edge ~1000, centre ~1118): recorded as two T's on Vine. Gano Alley is labelled only west of Lodge; the same 20 ft alley continues east of Lodge to Walnut (20' label at the Walnut end), treated as Gano Alley. Fountain Place is the narrow street entering 6th from the south (block outlines of sheet 119), about 35 px west of the Lodge centreline; name taken from the key map (Fountain Pl. on sheet 119). Lodge width: 20' printed at 7th; the label near 6th reads 25' or 27' (unclear). Much of the sheet is covered by 1920s-30s correction slips; corners taken from block lines outside the slips where possible. Piatt Alley continues west of Vine (gap in the Volume 1 block outlines) and Gano Alley continues east of Walnut (gap in the sheet 132 outlines), so both are crossings.
